ideas.title: Minnesota Fraud Scandal: A Deeper Dive
ideas.description: Investigate the Minnesota fraud scandal and the creation of the new anti-fraud task force. Look into the specific cases of fraud and the entities involved.
ideas.angle: Follow the money: tracing the flow of funds in the Minnesota fraud scandal
questions: What are the specific cases of fraud in Minnesota?
